'''Rod Latham Cloud City Troopers''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds12.htm Cloud City Troopers], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319172814/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds12.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
